provider: National e-Governance Division, Government of India
description: Fetches officially issued Indian government documents from a citizen's DigiLocker vault with their consent. Documents include Aadhaar card, PAN card, driving licence, voter ID, and marksheets issued by government bodies. Used as a secure, paperless way to obtain proof of identity and address during digital onboarding. DigiLocker documents are legally equivalent to original physical documents under the IT Act 2000.
use_cases: Paperless KYC document collection for digital onboarding
Fetching Aadhaar as proof of identity and address
Retrieving PAN card for income tax and identity verification
Driving licence fetch for age and identity verification
Voter ID retrieval as address proof
Marksheet or degree certificate fetch for income product eligibility
Document authenticity verification for loan processing
compliance_context: IT Act 2000 Section 4 — DigiLocker documents are legally equivalent to originals. UIDAI consent mandatory for Aadhaar document access. Data localisation norms apply.
typical_callers: Banks, NBFCs, insurance companies, digital lenders, telecom operators, educational institutions requiring government-issued identity or address proof
auth_description: OAuth2 authorization code flow. User authenticates with DigiLocker and grants access. Client ID and secret used to exchange code for access token.

required_fields.description: Type of government document to retrieve
OAuth2 access token proving user consent for document access
Application callback URL after DigiLocker authorization

optional_fields.description: Date of birth to cross-match with document record
Gender to match against document record

document_url.description: Signed URL to download the document

error_codes.400: Invalid document type or Aadhaar format.
